programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean cannot, for the life of him, place the face of the uninvited fat bloke on his doorstep. An old school photograph and school cap just about jog his memory. By this time his new ‘friend’ has put his feet up and is eating Bean out of house and home. This blast from the past proves to be a blasted pain in the neck.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion. Meanwhile Fred believes you can't solve a mystery on Halloween. But all is explained when the gang runs into a witch and Fred reveals that he ran into the same witch 11 years ago with his cousin.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It's Specs big night in the town with the lady of his dream. What could go wrong? The answer to that question might have do with the shapeshifting orange blob at the next table.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A helicopter takes off from the beach, leaving behind installations for a TV game, namely lots of food supplies – which are locked up. To access the keys and the food, participants must win team tests under the surveillance of a drone. The Lemmings are the yellow team. The red team is comprised of Grizzy, an oar, and a flabbergasted crab!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While trying to avoid the Lemmings' outboard speedboat, Grizzy punctures his air mattress and is propelled into a hidden grotto where he finds a conch decorated with Maori symbols that can control whales. Grizzy returns, proudly straddling his cetacean and chases the Lemmings from his peaceful spot. But the Lemmings' imagination is equal to the size of this potential new playmate!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While arguing over a jar of Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings happen upon a polar bear cub who is crying. When the little bear sees them, he wails even louder. Annoyed by his sobs, Grizzy and the rodents try to pacify him, but nothing works. After feeding and changing him, the baby finally falls asleep. How can they pick up their Yummy battle without waking the cub?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A meteorite falls not far from the cabin. While the Lemmings are sledding outside on a metal pot lid, their sled is abruptly drawn to the extraterrestrial boulder. In seventh heaven, the rodents start over again, this time using the TV satellite dish. But Grizzy, determined to get the dish back at any cost, must confront the magnetism of the meteorite and the fury of the Lemmings, for the rodents are set on playing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have set up a long line of dominos in the cabin that ends with several giant ice blocks and a rocket outside. Weary of not finding the peace and calm he loves so dearly, Grizzy sabotages the game. The rocket hits an ice block and blows up the cabin. Grizzy gets his hands on a machine that can sculpt ice. The bear dreams of an igloo, but the Lemmings have other projects.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A crafty cat burglar is causing alarm and concern throughout the town with a series of daring rooftop robberies. After Mrs Wicket’s house is burgled and Bean has his wallet stolen he decides the only way to deal with this cunning housebreaker is to don a costume and become a superhero (like the ones in his favourite comic book). But Super Bean soon finds he has his hands full helping to rescue cats stuck in trees and old ladies with their spilled shopping.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is tidying his flat and chucking out a load of old unwanted junk. Unfortunately during the big clear out Teddy accidentally falls into a bin bag which gets put out in the street. Bean is horrified when the rubbish van arrives and he realises that dear old Teddy is now on his way to the landfill. Bean races across town to the dump but how will he ever find his friend amongst all the mountains of junk?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys a robot to clean his flat but it ends up trashing half the town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants an ice cream from the ice cream van. But by the time he gets to the front of the queue the ice-cream man has gone to lunch. Bean takes it upon himself to climb through in an open window and into the back of the van from where he starts to help himself. Unfortunately he soon attracts a crowd and is forced to serve a long queue of kids until all the ice cream runs out. When the ice-cream man comes back from lunch and drives away he is unaware that Bean is still hiding in the back of his van en route to the ice cream factory.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Bibi and Batgirl team up with the fabulous magician of the Justice League, Zatana, and her amazing magic-using car, Presto!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Much to everyone’s surprise, Bam is secretly afraid of the dark. When Poison Ivy knocks out all the power in Gotham, Bam must conquer his fears to stop her.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: A music video introducing all of Batman's heroic vehicle squad - the Batwheels - showcasing their incredible gadgets, stunning talents, and unique personalities.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: To escape a snowstorm, the gang checks into a creepy, massive hotel run by a man very strict about the hotel rules established by his deceased mother. The gang soon discovers the penalty for breaking the hotel rules is a horrifying scolding from the ghost of the owner's mother, herself!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs are so obsessed with catching Lamput that even in their dreams, the chase goes on. It’s really not a restful sleep, when you keep waking up sweating from horrid visions that, let’s face it, just remind you what a nightmare your day job is. The Docs make the brave decision to see a therapist about these terrible dreams. In the waiting room is the last orange blob they wanted to see; apparently a life of hot pursuit is taking its toll on Lamput, too. The shrink will have to resort to some very unconventional treatments.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Big Rex, the island's most feared predator, imprints on Miguel after being saved from a rockslide. Convinced he can train the mighty T-Rex to help around HQ, Miguel brings him home! But between broken equipment and a very terrified herd of dinos, it's clear that Big Rex doesn't belong in captivity! And worse, the raptor trio is running wild, wreaking havoc now that their boss is gone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers spot a Mosasaurus, the ocean's mightiest predator! Min quickly realizes the mother Mosa has come here to give birth! After the baby is born, the exhausted mama drifts off to sleep. Min gives the newborn its first health check-up, but just as she finishes, the mother wakes! The enraged Mosa charges, triggering a rockslide that separates Min, Blitz, and the baby from the team!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s tranquillity is shattered by deafening roadworks outside his bedroom window. Threats, sabotage and subterfuge all fail to quell the cacophony until Bean has the ingenious idea of feeding the workmen into peaceful submission. But the silence ends with a bang!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover a fun new game: running on logs! While playing, the Baby lemmings find themselves racing Baby Lynx without realizing it. To the horror of Baby Lynx, who hates defeat, she loses the race! The Baby Lemmings with their logs are faster than Baby Lynx. Her pride stung, she decides to steal the vehicle that allows her to be faster.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. He decides to rake them up into nice, cubic heaps, not realizing that he's providing great cushions for the baby lemmings, who have fun throwing themselves into them making firework displays of colorful leaves! Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's a windy day in the Canadian forest, and Baby Lynx is having fun catching flying leaves like a little kitten. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks stumble across a potion called Grow Fastums in the woods. Squeaks disregards Bugs warnings and takes the potion as his own wreaking havoc throughout the forest.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A robotic rule enforcer has been placed in the local park and is spoiling everyone's fun. Bugs takes it upon himself to enforce some rules of his own.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs attempts the path less traveled and finds himself in yet another stand-off between the Hazmats and Bigfoot.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: The Grim Rabbit takes a vacation only to discover Bugs is there too. Despite his wife's ultimatum of No Smiting the Grim Rabbit is set on trying to mix business with pleasure.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopaedia, an upside-down dustbin and a club-hammer. Finally, Bean becomes the first man in history to wage war on a fly... with a fridge.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: In Catsylvania, a strange flying bug bites Tom, transforming him into a Tom-sized bug monster. Van Mouseling saves the village with an old-fashioned canister of bug poison, and Tom flies off to the abandoned castle on the hill. But Tom's troubles aren't over yet! Inside, he must deal with huge spider webs and a spider the size of a truck.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: At midnight, a gothic lady cat appears with her favorite sinister plant creatures including her personal favorite: Fang, a big man-eating plant. As long as it's sealed in the hothouse, nothing can go wrong. But Tom, Jerry and Tuffy soon have their hands full with the escaped plant.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is taking selfies and enjoying a sweet snack at the candy shop, when Jerry and Tuffy sneak up and eat his strawberries. Tom proceeds to chase after them, but Tuffy falls into the claw machine. Jerry tries to save him, and Tom fishes them out. Tom makes Tuffy cry and apologizes by feeding him sweets.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a crate of cell phones: there’s one for everyone. But before being able to play with their new toys, they need to charge the batteries. This operation uses all the electricity stored in the cabin’s solar battery and prevents Grizzy from watching TV. Grizzy soon realizes that this is the least of his worries, for living with the Lemmings and their phones is a guaranteed nonstop stream of noise pollution.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings catch a grasshopper that can give you whatever your heart desires in abundance. All you need to do is set the grasshopper on its head while concentrating hard on what you want. As discretion is not the Lemmings’ strong point, Grizzy ends up understanding where their profusion of toys is coming from. Grizzy decides that it’s his turn to hunt down the grasshopper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a new passion: magic Chinese lanterns that they use for sound and light performances. Grizzy is not very enthusiastic about this new electric activity which keeps him from sleeping. While Grizzy thinks that he got rid of their lanterns, the Lemmings discover new high-tech lanterns capable of making even more of a ruckus.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay hands on an ancient console that lets you play life-sized games in the real world. The console emits magical streams of energy that randomly pick avatars to confront one another. Grizzy is chosen as the hero. He must leap onto platforms and confront both enemies and a fearsome leader: a panda equipped with bamboo sticks. The Lemmings are obviously in control of the joystick!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As the Lemmings rummage through an abandoned delivery tricycle filled with strange objects, they discover a delicious treasure: Yummy-filled Chinese brioches! Grizzy steals their tasty bounty and heads off to enjoy it alone in the cabin. The Lemmings find a mask in the tricycle that terrifies anyone who looks at it when it’s being worn by someone. The Lemmings intend to use their horrific new power to recover their stolen treats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a jar of Yummy which is mysteriously sucked up into a strange gravestone locked with a puzzle. Grizzy smashes open the gravestone but it contains another box made of unbreakable wood protected with a codex system. Our characters crack the code and are sucked into the box in turn. They discover that to get out, they will have to resolve a series of new puzzles, each one more complex than the last.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kids and Skatestar must stop Rolloxtreme to protect the location Enigma’s secret base.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After refusing to practice with her new underwater mode, Batwing is unable to save Batman from Penguin's sunken ship trap. The Batwheels must help Wing practice her submersible skills before she can save the day.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After agreeing to swap motherboards and change bodies, the Batwheels have to quickly learn to “drive a mile in each other’s wheels” in time to stop the approaching Legion of Zoom!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. Always trying to one-up each other, these stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Mayor Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a water wheel in the forest where Porky worries about a mythical creature named “Big Feet.”

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build Tibs Squirrel a closet in his tree, but it won’t fit all of Tibs’ stuff and he doesn’t want to get rid of anything.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When The Looney Builders enter a sandcastle building contest, Tweety sees the competition and loses confidence in his idea.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Chef Hector hires The Looney Builders to build him a burger restaurant, but Daffy is so focused on beating his handheld game that he causes major setbacks.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: The crew celebrates the Lunar New Year and Bugs and Lola go missing during the Lion Dance.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean gets in a flap when a monster turns up in his cake-mix. The good news, though, is that the monster turns out to be a harmless baby bird. The bad news is that it grows into a huge stork and takes over his home. Bean attempts to return it to the wild, and finds teaching it to fly makes his arms ache.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When the frogspawn in Mr. Bean’s bath hatch out, it’s the last thing his landlady needs, especially when she’s invited the Mayor for tea. Hundreds of angry amphibians decide to invite themselves as well. Bean proves to be no expert at catching slippery green things that won’t stop hopping about all over the blinking place.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is captivated by a mime artist on TV who makes viewers believe in the presence of an invisible wall. To get rid of the Lemmings, who have sights on his jar of Yummy, Grizzy hides the jar and pretends he has an invisible one. When the Lemmings see through the trick, they decide to trap Grizzy with a grand illusion number.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings shiver with cold, sneeze and are glassy-eyed: they have a big fat cold! They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

programme.title: Atentāts pret Džonu Kenediju
programme.desc: Tas bija noziegums, kas satrieca un mainīja ASV. Šis aizraujošais dokumentālais stāsts, kas aplūko liktenīgos 1963. gada 22. novembra notikumus, kad tika noslepkavots prezidents Džons F. Kenedijs. Dokumentālais darbs no trim dažādiem skatpunktiem pēta prezidenta drošības vadītāja Roja Kellermena, slepkavas Lī Hārvija Osvalda un pirmās lēdijas Džekijas Kenedijas darbības pirms apšaudes.

programme.title: Pazudis

programme.title: Pazudis

programme.title: Pazudis
programme.desc: 19 gadus vecais Endžels Garsija pazudis pēc izbrauciena pa Hartfordu. Draugi saka, ka pirms notikuma Garsiju vajājis kāds noslēpumains apvidus auto. Pēc vairākiem mēnešiem 15 jūdzes no notikuma vietas varētu būt pamanīts Endžels.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta
programme.desc: Dodžsitijā divas sievietes devušās nakts dzīvē, kur sastopas ar potenciālajiem piegulētājiem. Līdz ar rīta gaismu atklājas, ka viena no sievietēm savās mājās atrasta mirusi. Sākas izmeklēšana par viņas pēdējām dzīves stundām.

programme.title: Noslepkavots no rīta

programme.title: Vientuļā dzērusī sieviete

programme.title: Vientuļā dzērusī sieviete
programme.desc: Sema spriež vai viņa var pāriet darbā no sava vecā es, vienlaikus mēģinot orientēties attiecībās ar normālo. Kerola ielūkojas Semas istabā un izdara šausmīgu atklājumu. Džoels un Džeimss kopīgi pavada vakaru.

programme.title: Vientuļā dzērusī sieviete
programme.desc: Pēc tam, kad Sema uzzina, ka Kerola ir pārkāpusi viņas privātumu, abas sāk sprādzienbīstamu cīņu, liekot Bobam mēģināt būt par starpnieku. Kamēr ar Pīteru viss iet labi, Felīcija saņem nevēlamu ciemiņu no viņas pagātnes.

programme.title: Noziegums kuru atcerēties
programme.desc: Losandželosa, 1922. gads. Tiek atrasts miris vīrs, un viņa sieva atrasta ieslodzīta skapī. Izmeklētāji procesā apmaldās pakļaušanas un apsēstības pasaulē, kur spoki ir vairāk nekā īsti.

programme.title: Noziegums kuru atcerēties
programme.desc: Santakruza, 1970. gads. Sašauta un noslīcināta pašu baseinā atrasta vesela ģimene. Izmeklētājiem jāizburas cauri psihodēlisku hipiju komūnām, meklējot atbildes uz šo neaptveramo noziegumu.

programme.title: Algota slepkavība

programme.title: Algota slepkavība
programme.desc: Pēc šķiršanās un biznesa bankrota atriebīgs vīrietis nežēlīgi vajā personu, kas, viņaprāt, ir nodarījis pāri. Policijai jāizmanto neparasta taktika, lai palīdzētu nodrošināt šīs personas drošību.

Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk and Tim Minear reimagine the procedural drama with 9-1-1. The series explores the high-pressure experiences of first responders -- including police officers, firefighters and dispatchers -- who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations. These emergency responders must try to balance saving those who are at their most vulnerable with solving the problems in their own lives. The show draws from real-life, high-pressure experiences of first responders who regularly face heart-stopping situations that are often unpredictable, intense and uplifting at the same time.

Realizing that the titular alien is fictional, they create a real Funbucket, who tires of them and befriends humans Travis and Avery. Forced to attend high school, Yumyulack and Jesse are menaced by their classmates and faculty. They shrink a bully named Lydia, hoping to use her to study human behavior. As the Shlorpian family have dinner together, it is revealed that their pet, the Pupa, will one day evolve and destroy Earth to terraform a new Shlorp.

programme.title: BlackBerry
programme.desc: m. Vaterlo mieste, Ontarijuje, „Research in Motion“ (RIM) generalinis direktorius Maikas Lazaridis ir jo geriausias draugas bei vienas iš įkūrėjų Daglasas Freginas ruošiasi pasiūlyti verslininkui Džimiui Baziliui investuoti į savo sukurto mobiliojo ryšio įrenginio gamybą. Įvykus susitarimui Maikui ir Daglasui prasideda aukso amžius. Telefonas su klaviatūra, kuriuo galima rašyti elektroninius laiškus, įneša tikrą proveržį technologijų pasaulyje. Jo nori visi, bet tikrai ne visi gali sau leisti tokią naujovę. Tačiau tuomet, kai „Blackberry“ kyla į naujas viršūnes, į rinką įžengia Steve‘o Jobso „iPhone“. „Blackberry“ kūrėjams nesugebėjus prisitaikyti prie kintančios rinkos ir likus prie senos technologijos, konkurentai gauna puikų šansą palaidoti juos užmarštyje. Nesugebėjimas susitarti su mobiliojo ryšio operatoriais nuo beveik 50 procentų išmaniųjų telefonų rinkos JAV, bei milijardinių pajamų – krenta iki nulio.

programme.title: Kietas riešutėlis 4.0
programme.desc: JAV, Vašingtonas, liepos 4-oji. Kol amerikiečiai švenčia nepriklausomybės dieną, teroristai nemiega. Jie rengia kompiuterinę ataką prieš Jungtinių Valstijų infrastruktūrą, tikėdamiesi nublokšti Ameriką atgal į „Tamsos amžių“. Sąmokslo organizatoriai, rodos, apskaičiavo kiekvieną smulkmeną. Tačiau jie nesitikėjo, kad vykdydami planą, turės įveikti “kietąjį riešutėlį” – senamadiškąjį Niujorko detektyvą Džoną Makleiną (akt. Bruce Willis).

programme.title: Kietas riešutėlis. Puiki diena mirti
programme.desc: Kad galėtų Maskvoje padėti savo nenuspėjamam sūnui Džekui, Džonas Makleinas pirmą kartą ryžtasi vykti į svečią šalį, neįtardamas, kad Džekas iš tikrųjų yra profesionalus CŽV agentas, kurio užduotis - padaryti galą atominių ginklų vagystei. Iki tikro karo tiksint sekundėms, abu Makleinai veikdami savo, atrodytų, nesuderinamais metodais, kovoja su rusų nusikaltėliais ir tampa nesustabdomais didvyriais.

World Autism Awareness Day is on 2nd April.

programme.title: Leo's World
programme.desc: Leo’s World is the award-winning Italian cartoon TV series that is primarily aimed at children with autism spectrum disorder and at the same time is suitable for all pre-school children. World Autism Awareness Day is on 2nd April.

programme.title: Teaduspauk

programme.desc: Jack and Katrina investigate the site of one of the bloodiest massacres in Colonial America. It is reported that the ghosts of dead soldiers haunt the location.

programme.title: Vienam gale kablys
programme.desc: Sako, pasaulyje jų milijonai... Lietuvoje – šimtai tūkstančių... Savaitgaliais – jų rankose meškerės ir juos galima rasti prie pačių įvairiausių Lietuvos upių, ežerų ir tvenkinių. Jų kalbos sukasi tik apie žuvis, žūklės įrankius, orų prognozes ir geriausias žvejybos vietas Lietuvoje ir pasaulyje. Laida „Vienam gale kablys“ jau daugelį metų draugauja su šiais gerąja prasme išprotėjusiais žmonėmis, kurių kasmet vis daugiau. Laidos vedėjas Paulius Korsakas keliauja su meškerėmis po gražiausias ir žuvingiausias mūsų šalies ir pasaulio vietas ir džiugina žiūrovus netikėtais reportažais, patarimais ir, žinoma, naujienomis, skirtomis šiam puikiam pomėgiui – pramoginei žūklei. „Vienam gale kablys“ TV6 eteryje – tai ir puiki pramoga, ir gamtos jausmas, naujausi patarimai ir žūklės būdai, didžiausios pagautos ir paleistos žuvys bei įdomūs žinomi žmonės su meškerėmis rankose.

programme.title: Šeima lygtinai
programme.desc: Šeimos atostogos namelyje ant ratų tapo tikru iššūkiu. Vyro meilužė, nuslypėti žmonos atostogų planai ir vaikų nesutarimai. Ar pavyks šeimynai išgyventi „linksmas“ atostogas kartu?

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Viena diena
programme.desc: Jauna, neturtinga, tyros sielos svajotoja visiems linki tik gero. Baigdama universitetą ji susipažįsta su nerūpestingu mergišiumi Deksteriu. Šis į gyvenimą žvelgia lengvabūdiškai, nes sunkumų jis neturi. Pamatysime, kaip ši pora bendrauja dvidešimt metų. Kaip patiria džiaugsmus, sunkumus, širdgėlą. Kaip siekia įgyvendinti svajones ir kaip jų požiūris į gyvenimą nuolat keičiasi.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Bruto ir Neto
programme.desc: Serialas žiūrovus vėl nukels į įprastą lietuvišką kaimą, kuriame dedasi visai neįprasti dalykai. Keršto vedamas aktoriaus Vaidoto Martinaičio vaidinamas Pranas mintimis grįš į laikus, kai bandydamas atsisakyti alkoholio apsigyveno arabų kraštuose. Būdamas šiltuose kraštuose Pranas išmoko maisto gaminimo paslapčių, todėl nuspręs Gaisrių kaime atidaryti restoraną, susilauksiantį neregėto populiarumo. Tačiau pagrindinis Prano tikslas bus pasipriešinti konkurentams – naujai hipsterių porai, kurių vaidmenis atliks aktoriai Karina Stungytė ir Eimutis Kvosčiauskas. Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Pačios geriausios draugės
programme.desc: Kai pasaulis byra į šipulius, Emilija ir Paula randa stiprybę, padėdamos viena kitai. Nutrauktos Emilijos sužadėtuvės ir Paulos liga suartina moteris. Tačiau išaiškėja, kad Paula jaučia savo draugei daug daugiau ir net sukompromitavo vieną iš jos vestuvinių dovanų. Kaip pasielgs Emilija sužinojusi tiesą?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Šią vasarą TV3 žiūrovai išvys populiaraus lietuviško serialo „Moterų laimė“ jau antrąjį sezoną. Serialas kuriamas pagal visame pasaulyje didžiulio populiarumo sulaukusį daugiaserijinį filmą. Pastarasis rodomas daugiau nei penkiasdešimtyje pasaulio šalių, tarp kurių – JAV, Kanada, Indija, Meksika, o serialo žiūrimumas užsienyje – rekordiškai didelis. „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kobra 11
programme.desc: Sudėtingos bylos, pašėlusios gaudynės, profesionaliai atlikti nutrūktgalviški triukai... Zemyras su partneriu ir vėl persekios ne tik eismo taisyklių pažeidėjus, žudikus ir šantažuotojus. Jie tirs banko apiplėšimą, paslaptingas avarijas ir netgi pateks į nusikaltėlių pinkles.

Laida „Vienam gale kablys“ jau daugelį metų draugauja su šiais gerąja prasme išprotėjusiais žmonėmis, kurių kasmet vis daugiau. Laidos vedėjas Paulius Korsakas keliauja su meškerėmis po gražiausias ir žuvingiausias mūsų šalies ir pasaulio vietas ir džiugina žiūrovus netikėtais reportažais, patarimais ir, žinoma, naujienomis, skirtomis šiam puikiam pomėgiui – pramoginei žūklei. „Vienam gale kablys“ TV6 eteryje – tai ir puiki pramoga, ir gamtos jausmas, naujausi patarimai ir žūklės būdai, didžiausios pagautos ir paleistos žuvys bei įdomūs žinomi žmonės su meškerėmis rankose.

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Maisto tinklaraštininkė, nuomonės formuotoja, knygų autorė Kotryna Starkienė imsis užduoties ruošti patiekalus iš sezoninių produktų, savo sodyboje Dzūkijoje užaugintų daržovių, surinktų uogų, grybų ar iš vietinių augintojų pirktos mėsos. Kotryna gamins tiek kasdienius, kiekvienam lengvai paruošiamus patiekalus, tiek šventinius, skirtus specialioms progoms, nepamiršdama desertų. Laidoje bus ir buitinių patarimų – kaip paprasčiausiai išvalyti skalbimo mašiną, kaip padaryti, kad medinės pjaustymo lentelės vėl atrodytų, kaip naujos, kaip išlyginti staltiesę, kai neturite lygintuvo.

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Hortonas
programme.desc: Drambiukas Hortonas linksmai leidžia dienas ir netikėtai išgirsta balsus. Aplinkui nieko nesimato, bet girdisi tikrai aiškiai. Pasirodo, net mažoje dulkelėje gali slypėti jaukus miestukas su mielais žmogeliais. Jie yra kasiukai, o jų miestas – Kasvilis. Hortonas privalo išgelbėti naujuosius draugus nuo pražūties. Deja, niekas iš drambliuko pažįstamų juo netiki, jo pasakojimus laiko prasimanymu. Bet atkaklusis drambliukas yra įsitikinęs, kad ir menkiausiam padarėliui reikia ištiesti pagalbos ranką.

programme.title: Mano mažasis karalius
programme.desc: Aleksas ir Inesa gyvena įprastą gyvenimą. Rytais skuba į mokyklą, o grįžę namo po pamokų bando prasimanyti pramogų. Tačiau vieną dieną rutina sprogsta į šipulius, nes namuose jie patinka liūto jauniklį. Tą patį vakarą visos šalies žiniasklaidos priemonės rėkte rėkia, kad pervežimo metu ir vietos oro uosto paspruko liūto jauniklis. Paskelbiama aukščiausio lygio paieška. Vaikai negali susitaikyti su tuo, kad nuostabus liūtukas bus uždarytas narve. Aleksas ir Inesa nusprendžia grąžinti gyvūną į jo namus Afrikoje. Pasiekti kitą žemyną ne taip paprasta, tad į pagalba jie pasikviečia savo senelį Maksą. Vos porą kartų matytas senolis yra tikras keliauninkas ir priima vaiku kvietimą. Pavojų kupina kelionė prasideda.

programme.title: Už priešo linijos 2. Blogio ašis
programme.desc: Žlugus misijai sunaikinti Šiaurės Korėjos raketų bazę, keturi JAV karinio jūrų laivyno specialios paskirties pajėgų būrio nariai atsiduria priešo teritorijoje. Likimo valiai palikti amerikiečiai grumiasi su priešiškai nusiteikusiais korėjiečiais, grasinančiais sunaikinti visą pasaulį.

programme.title: 21 tiltas
programme.desc: Neeilinio nusikaltimo Niujorke metu susišaudyme su nusikaltėliais žūsta net aštuoni policininkai. Detektyvas Andrė Deivisas (akt. Chadwick Boseman, „Juodoji pantera“) gauna užduotį bet kokia kaina sugauti nusikaltėlius.
